# EcoPower Suite

> Intelligent Windows Energy Optimization, Multi-Monitor Dimming & Power Management Utility.

## Project Summary
EcoPower Suite is a lightweight, standalone, open-source Windows utility (Windows 10 & 11, 64-bit) designed to reduce idle PC electricity consumption by up to 40% and extend laptop battery life. It operates 100% offline with zero telemetry, zero adware, and zero background network connections.

## Key Capabilities
- **Universal Hardware Dimming**: VESA DDC/CI monitor backlight dimming over HDMI/DisplayPort, and internal laptop screen brightness via WMI.
- **Smart Battery Balancing**: Automatically transitions laptops to Balanced mode upon AC disconnection to protect battery life without aggressive screen blinding.
- **AI & Bot Workload Shield**: Detects active local AI inference (Ollama, LM Studio, ComfyUI, PyTorch, llama.cpp), developer bot scripts (Python, Node), and GPU CUDA compute (>15% load), preventing idle sleep or CPU throttling during active compute.
- **Non-Destructive One-Shot Architecture**: All commands execute as clean one-shot events without intrusive polling loops overriding manual user choices.
- **Scheduled Automated Shutdown**: Integrates with Windows Task Scheduler with a 30-second warning alert, 1-hour snooze, or today cancel option.

## CLI & Autonomous Bot Interface
Bots, AI agents, and scripts can execute headless commands directly:
- `EcoPowerSuite.exe --status [--json]`: Returns real-time wattage, brightness, battery, and AI shield status in structured JSON.
- `EcoPowerSuite.exe --mode <eco|balanced|perf> [--json]`: Sets power profile instantly in one shot.
- `EcoPowerSuite.exe --brightness <0-100> [--json]`: Sets monitor backlight level.
- `EcoPowerSuite.exe --ai-shield [--json]`: Queries AI and bot workload detection status.

## Verified Security & Cryptographic Integrity
- **Antivirus Detection**: 0/72 Clean across major engines (Microsoft Defender, Kaspersky, Bitdefender).
- **Executable**: `EcoPowerSuite.exe` (v1.0.0, ~22.1 MB standalone)
- **SHA-256 Checksum**: `A2F31F1029EDA4D72F72AFCA526DA86C6EB844AC213D846E0CDB5FA25C98DE75`
- **Verification Command (PowerShell)**: `Get-FileHash .\EcoPowerSuite.exe -Algorithm SHA256`
